lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spacing between centroids is relatively uniform across the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes where luminance values are locally maximized.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper lateral flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and low-intensity shadow pixels on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small high-luminance blobs localized within the visible macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily clustered near the leading edge and base.

other_distinctive_markers: Two associated remora silhouettes are visible: one positioned on the dorsal ridge anterior to the first dorsal fin and another trailing near the ventral-pectoral region.
